narrative.intro: MVM appears as an active federal contractor in FY2026 to date with $234M in contract obligations. The company received 6 awards so far, with an average award size of $39.1M, and obligations are up 26.0% year over year. The Department of Homeland Security is the dominant buyer, providing $234M in obligations this fiscal year. MVM’s spending is concentrated in Security Guards and Patrol Services, which accounts for $234M of obligations in FY2026 to date. Historical obligations by fiscal year are: FY21 $497M, FY22 $769M, FY23 $303M, FY24 $344M, FY25 $186M, FY26 $234M. Current-year totals are partial because the fiscal year is still in progress. The page treats the listed figures as contract obligations except where tables label award-value figures as total contract values. This snapshot highlights where MVM’s federal revenue is coming from and how that revenue sits against prior fiscal years.
